why: A July 2026 arXiv preprint proves every bridgeless (P/e)-minor-free multigraph (excluding the Petersen graph with one edge contracted) has a nowhere-zero 4-flow, extending a 2009 result; (P/e)-minor-free is a stronger exclusion than Petersen-minor-free, so it is unclear whether this counts as a genuine restricted case of the stated conjecture or a distinct, narrower excluded-minor problem. The general Tutte 4-flow conjecture for Petersen-minor-free graphs itself remains reported as open.
